name: hexamidine diisethionate
uses: Use ▪ Helps relieve symptoms of fungal and inflammatory skin conditions, including: – Folliculitis – Dandruff – Seborrheic dermatitis – Tinea versicolor – Jock itch ▪ Reduces itching, flaking, redness, and irritation
otcwarn: Do not use ▪ On broken or severely damaged skin without consulting a doctor Ask Doctor ▪ A known allergy to any of the listed ingredients ▪ Severe skin conditions not diagnosed by a doctor Stop Use ▪ Irritation or rash occurs and lasts

src.label: PHARMBANNER Anti-Fungal Shampoo.
src.maker: Shenzhen Xinxin Yunhai Technology Co., Ltd.
